description: This file defines the AnnotatedClassDiscovery class, which implements a plugin discovery mechanism in Drupal by scanning PSR-4 namespaces for annotated plugin classes, utilizing Doctrine annotations, file caching, and reflection.

classes.name: AnnotatedClassDiscovery
classes.description: A class that discovers annotated plugin classes within specified PSR-4 namespaces, using Doctrine annotations, reflection, and caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the discovery with plugin namespaces, annotation name, and additional namespaces.

methods.name: getAnnotationReader
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine annotation reader, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Scans namespaces for PHP classes with specific annotations, caches results, and returns plugin definitions.

methods.name: prepareAnnotationDefinition
methods.description: Associates a class name with an annotation object.
